name: reconcile_enclosing_history
command:
import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import json,re,hashlib,subprocess,sys
lane=Path.cwd();matches=json.loads(Path('history-matches.json').read_text());out=[]
for x in matches:
 if x['json_path'] not in ['/377304/record','/377303/record','/377305/record','/377673/literal_record']:continue
 p=Path(x['file']);assert not any(re.search(r'(formal|code[-_]?loop|polynexus|crown|tournament|bunkbed|(?:^|[-_])hat(?:[-_.]|$)|r395|r463|r466|r482|r490|cubical-zigzag)',s,re.I) for s in p.parts)
 data=p.read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==json.loads(Path('historical-results-allowlist.json').read_text())[str(p)]
 o=json.loads(data)[x['json_path'].split('/')[1]];o={k:v for k,v in o.items() if k not in ['record','literal_record']};out.append({'file':str(p),'value':o});print(json.dumps(out[-1],ensure_ascii=False))
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(lane/'write_lane.py'),'history-enclosing-dispositions.json'],input=json.dumps(out,indent=2),capture_output=True,text=True);assert r.returncode==0
